mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.0% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate financing costs decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% triggers aggressive monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% MoM signal broad consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline >0.5% MoM, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% indicates labor market weakness, prompting accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) above 102.0 indicates expanding manufacturing output, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 102.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) below 0.5% annualized signals recession risk, triggering profit margin compression and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 < 0.5% annualized, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) combined with rising policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) indicates active monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing market downturn (HOUST declining > 1.0% MoM) triggers immediate consumer confidence erosion, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as demand shocks materialize.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST declines >1.0% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
